attributes.about_brand: Driven by the love for fragrance, Adil Qadri specialises in crafting exceptional scents using the most exquisite and rare ingredients gathered globally. The objective of the brand is to present a diverse collection of fragrances that cater to every individual's unique tastes and desires. The brand offers timeless traditional scents and daring contemporary perfumes, ensuring that they have a fragrance for every occasion or personal preference.

attributes.about_brand: With food infused with our ancestors' passed-on Ayurvedic and traditional wisdom, Anveshan assures wholesome, chemical-free and preservative-free food straight from the farms. Prepared locally by micro-entrepreneurs in villages, Anveshan helps empower and secure local families. Delivery of preservative-free food is ensured with farm-to-fork transparency with tech-enabled quality analysers and in-house, state-of-the-art certified labs to test every batch before packaging.

attributes.about_brand: With a legacy spanning over half a century, Bathla has been at the forefront of designing simple, functional, and aesthetically pleasing home essentials that transform the way you experience daily life. This remarkable journey, which began more than five decades ago, is a testament to the brand's enduring commitment to making life easier and more enjoyable for you. The brand now has over 800 products across a growing number of categories that also include ironing boards, cloth drying stands, bathroom fittings, mops, bins, cleaning supplies and more.

Beanly has become synonymous with premium coffee, setting a high standard that continues to redefine the world of coffee, one cup at a time. Whether it's their flavoured instant coffee or their triple-filtered draft cold brews, Beanly's dedication to excellence shines through in every sip, making it the go-to choice for those who demand nothing but the best from their coffee.

From humble beginnings and after years of passionate efforts, Dhampur Green has been able to make jaggery a mainstream and staple food that finds a home in almost every household pantry kitchen and grocery list. The brand tried to showcase how Gur can be your ‘go-to’ sugar for all sweetening needs. With a vision to promote a greener and healthier future, Dhanpur Green remains at the forefront of the organic and sustainable agriculture movement. Their unwavering dedication to preserving the environment, being women-centric, supporting farming communities, and providing consumers with organic alternatives has positioned Dhanpur Green as a leading brand in the quest for a sustainable and eco-friendly world.

With authentic and innovative food offerings, BoYo was presented as an opportunity that could very well be a step toward a healthy lifestyle for millions of Indians. BoYo represents the modern Indian that is bold and young, as BoYo share the same passion with their snacks.

With an extensive collection of high-quality leather accessories for both men and women, Brown Bear meticulously crafts a diverse range of colors and distinctive designs ofeach product. The brand’s offerings serve as exceptional gift items and are perfect for personal use as well. Whether catering to fashion-savvy local customers or discerning overseas clients, it ensures a wide selection to suit diverse preferences, allowing everyone to discover that elusive, one-of-a-kind piece they desire.

Budli redefines the tech landscape with hassle-free selling of old laptops and smartphones from the comfort of your home or office. Offering instant price quotes and secure transactions, Budli refurbishes, recycles, and resells gadgets to reduce e-waste, fostering both monetary gains and environmental sustainability. Every refurbished iPhone or laptop undergoes rigorous quality checks, ensuring glitch-free devices for purchase.

With a keen eye on customer feedback and an emphasis on research and exploration of audio technology, they have emerged as pioneers in the field. From meticulously crafted wooden structures to cutting-edge PCBs and Passive Radiators, Deciwood is proud to make everything right in India, creating extraordinary and high-quality music experiences for the discerning listener. Rooted in a mission to provide music enthusiasts with a harmonious blend of modern technology and classic-retro aesthetics, Deciwood offers an auditory journey that takes you on a nostalgic trip through time.

Doodle Collection is a vibrant and imaginative brand that celebrates the joy of creativity and self-expression. With a wide range of beautifully designed stationery and lifestyle products, Doodle Collection invites you to unleash your artistic spirit and embark on a journey of endless possibilities.
As Doodle Collection continues to innovate and expand its product offerings, it remains dedicated to inspiring individuals to embrace their unique voices and unlock their full creative potential.

attributes.about_brand:
With a deep-rooted passion for taste, health and innovation, Epigamia redefines the way we experience food. The visionary brand celebrates the art of crafting wholesome and delectable food products that cater to diverse palates and lifestyles. From creamy yoghourts to indulgent spreads and more, each creation is thoughtfully curated to deliver an unparalleled taste experience.
Their commitment to prioritising quality, transparency, sourcing the finest ingredients and employing rigorous quality control measures ensures making healthy choices that are accessible, nourish your body and delight your taste buds.

FOMO champions authenticity, sourcing ingredients like teas, honey, and sugar from rural India. Displeased by the deceptive practices in beverage industry, especially the high prices for sugary drinks, they crafted refreshing iced teas using natural ingredients.

attributes.sub_title: Hygiene Meets Comfort At Essential Discounts
attributes.about_brand: FemiSafe emerged amidst the challenges of the Covid-19 pandemic, which highlighted limited access to sanitary napkins, disposal issues and various menstrual health concerns. With a strong commitment to shatter stigmas and taboos surrounding menstruation and feminine hygiene, FemiSafe stands out through its active engagement with communities. As a comprehensive destination for women's personal care and hygiene needs, FemiSafe is revolutionising the industry and empowering women.

Gramiyaa oils are crafted with care, as wood and stone mills work their magic. Unheated and chemical-free, the oils are extracted as nature intended. With extensive R&D, the Gramiyaa team built traditional stone mills inside a modern hygienic facility to extract oil with minimal processing. Nutrition and flavour are retained with this process. The brand takes pride in empowering local oil makers, revitalising their craft for a brighter future.

Gud Gum's mission goes beyond its eco-friendly packaging; it extends to uplifting the livelihoods of tribal farmers who harvest the tree sap used in their gum. Drawing inspiration from the Mayan people, who have been chewing gum made from tree sap for millennia, Gud Gum is not just a delightful treat for your taste buds but a conscious choice for a greener Earth. Gud Gum biodegrades in 5-6 months, offering 100% plant-based, sugar-free chewing with natural sweeteners like Xylitol and Stevia – a tasty, sustainable choice at just 1 calorie.

Drawing from India's finest perfumeries, the brand crafts exquisite attars and perfumes. Each scent not only features the rarest ingredients but also reflects centuries of Indian perfume expertise. Passion drives every bottle, ensuring customers experience the rich heritage of Indian fragrance craftsmanship. Hasan Oud strives to share the beauty and tradition of perfumery with the world, making every spritz an indulgent journey through scent and culture.

Honey and Spice adheres to a philosophy of pure and unadulterated honey. The brand embarks on a nationwide journey connecting with small farmers, tribal honey harvesters, and beekeepers to curate the finest offerings from nature. Collaborating with farmers and indigenous forest tribes from various regions in India, Honey and Spice's mission is to preserve the Earth's biodiversity, support local communities, and uphold traditional methods.

Catering to the diverse tastes of Indian women, Iraah ensures a perfect fusion of contemporary trends and age-old craftsmanship. Collaborating with the finest weavers nationwide, Iraah brings you the rich heritage of Indian states through intricate designs and traditional patterns. As a top-notch online ethnic store, they take pride in presenting a premium catalogue featuring designer sarees that are both trendy and stylish. With hassle-free online saree shopping and nationwide shipping, Iraah Store aims to make every woman look graceful and feel special in their exclusive sarees, from everyday cotton to glamorous silk.

attributes.sub_title: Making a Difference At  Eco-friendly Discounts
attributes.about_brand: Irida Naturals specialises in selling homeware and kitchenware that's not just amazing but also kind to the planet. The team worked hard to find eco-friendly alternatives for kitchen and homeware that are top-notch in quality and toughness. These thoughtfully made products are meant to guide you towards a more sustainable lifestyle. The brand believes in tackling plastic waste, together. The goal is to build a community of like-minded folks sharing awareness and knowledge about living in a positive and eco-friendly way.

From carefully curated formulas to their unwavering dedication to quality, KAIVA is devoted to providing exceptional skincare and haircare experiences. KAIVA's dedication to purity is evident in every aspect of their brand. From the selection of ingredients to the formulation process, they prioritise utilising only the finest organic elements. By doing so, KAIVA ensures that their products are free from harsh chemicals and artificial additives, promoting the overall well-being of your skin and hair.

With a heart for customer satisfaction, they tirelessly source the cutest products worldwide, ensuring hassle-free delivery to your doorstep. Their values shine through personalized service, prioritizing your needs with live customer support and dedicated shipping. Kawaii Kart's vision? To spread joy with every purchase, offering top-quality, adorable goodies to every K-Pop and Anime enthusiast in India, making gifting a breeze.

Keventer caters to the ‘needs’ and the ‘wants’ of consumers by satisfying their daily nutrition needs and delighting them with a range of indulgent and ‘on-the-go’ products as well as verages and diary products. The brand’s ‘ready-to-eat’ and ‘ready-to-cook’ products facilitate ease of cooking for onsumers.

Born from the belief that true beauty lies in nature, Khadi Essentials is a brand that celebrates the power of Ayurveda and the goodness of organic ingredients. With a commitment to sustainability and ethical practices, Khadi Essentials fosters a connection with the natural world and embraces conscious living. The brand believes that beauty rituals should be a sensorial experience, one that uplifts your senses and nourishes the soul. The formulations are meticulously crafted to deliver effective results while enveloping you in the captivating scents and textures that nature has to offer.

Driven by a passion for wholesome, natural ingredients, Kikibix was born from a desire to provide consumers with a range of high-quality, nourishing snacks. Drawing inspiration from cherished childhood recipes passed down through generations, the brand is dedicated to recreating the goodness of homemade snacks without the harmful additives.

As an Indian skincare brand, they devoted considerable time to analysing the diverse Indian demographics and understanding the varying distribution of skin types across regions. Through extensive scientific research and utilizing solely 100% natural ingredients, the brand has developed its No Harm Skin Care range, designed to nurture skin health from within.

Lil Goodness is centred around the idea that small changes can make big differences in people’s lives.
The brand believes that by making conscious choices and incorporating healthy habits into daily routines, individuals can achieve optimal physical and mental health.
The brand is quickly gaining popularity among modern health-conscious consumers who are looking for convenient and tasty ways to maintain a healthy lifestyle. Lil Goodness, with its commitment to quality and community, is poised to become a leading name in the health and wellness industry not only with healthy products but by donating a portion of its profits to various health & wellness institutions.

M&Y Pehnava is a vibrant tribute to India's ethnic design traditions. 'Pehnava', meaning dressing, encapsulates the brand's essence. The brand crafts delightful ethnic designs inspired by India's rich crafts. The collection spans contemporary fashion and traditional wear, including Hand Blocked Printed Cotton Kurta Sets, Georgette Kurti Sets, Designer Lehengas, Punjabi Suits, and more. Each piece, from sketch to finish, is a unique expression of style, enticing visitors with both design and affordable prices.

Mad Over Print aims to push the boundaries of fashion, challenge the status quo, explore uncharted territories, and create fashion that's as unique as each person is. The brand helps you form self-expression, make a statement, and simply to unleash your creativity.

With the increased awareness for grooming for men & a variety of men's face grooming products floating around, grooming is no longer associated with a particular gender but a norm for everyone to pursue. The brand’s well researched and fully dermatologically range of skincare are tested to create a safe and secure experience for men and their specific requirements.

The need to find the right fuel for our bodies has become more apparent than ever. Millé's delicious and nutritious product range provides customers with healthy food options containing high plant protein, fibre, natural ingredients, and minimal sugar. Incorporating Millé into every meal helps maintain an active and light lifestyle throughout the day, combat cravings, and enjoy guilt-free indulgences.

With a belief in nature's transformative power, MINATURE crafts non-toxic, cruelty-free products rooted in traditional herbal practices. The brand offers premium-grade herbal powders, tablets, and capsules. From skincare to overall health, MINATURE accompanies you on your wellness journey. Embrace nature's power with us and discover the purity and authenticity of holistic wellness.

NYNM’s journey is not merely about solving hair-related problems; it's about fostering a community that understands their hair’s uniqueness and what it needs to not have those problems in the first place. They encourage individuals to embrace their unique hair textures and styles, fostering a sense of pride and confidence in one's natural beauty. Through educational initiatives and informative content, Niym empowers their customers to make informed choices and embark on a holistic hair care journey.

Niblerzz is a homegrown candy brand on a mission to redefine the candy experience. With a range of clean-label candies that allow you to indulge in sweet treats without compromising on your health or values, the brand is set to reimagine the joy of guilt-free indulgence.

Nomad Food Project was born out of a realisation of the gap in the market for unique and adaptable food products to satisfy the hunger pangs of Indian consumers. This realisation led the brand to experiment with bacon, a universally loved ingredient. The brand’s mission was to create unconventional recipes that not only served as spreads but also as versatile accompaniments, dips, or even delectable treats straight from the jar. Their innovative approach has revolutionised the way people enjoy bacon, eliminating the hassle of cooking it from scratch.

Hydroponics is defined as a method of growing plants in water, rather than in soil. This 100% self-funded company focuses on the betterment of human society and works in a sustainable manner to put food to your plate. It invested in building latest tech and automation so use the purest of water for your food, you don't have to use any chemical pesticides and have automated the whole supply chain.

Parista Foods is your gateway to a healthier, more vibrant lifestyle. The brand is dedicated to crafting food products that prioritise your well-being and provide you with the nourishment your body deserves. Parista Food’s commitment to quality, health, and taste sets them apart in the realm of nutrition.

Paul Penders advocates the philosophy that true beauty comes from within and healthy, glowing skin results from a balanced lifestyle. The brand emphasises the importance of using natural, nourishing skincare products and offers a wide range of products including cleansers, toners, moisturisers, serums, and more, all formulated to nourish and protect the skin.
In addition to its commitment to using natural and organic ingredients, Paul Penders is also committed to sustainability and ethical sourcing, packaged in recyclable or biodegradable materials.

Peore breaks barriers with nanotechnology, granting everyone access to superior drinking water. Their innovative approach ensures purified, clean water, promoting a healthier and sustainable lifestyle. Founded by an IIT Delhi alumi, Peore aims to offer high-quality water without gimmicks. Through awareness, on-ground presence, and groundbreaking technologies like Nanofiltration and Tru-UV, Peore believes in providing tailored purification solutions for every consumer's needs.

Plush products are not mere solutions for menstruation; they are meticulously designed with a deep consideration for women and their well-being. Plush's core philosophy goes beyond personal comfort; it extends to the planet's well-being as well, setting a new standard for feminine care that is as compassionate as it is comfortable.
